African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) (in force 2019; Egypt ratified)
Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa (COMESA) (Egypt is a member)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering (as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014 and Law No. 5 of 2016); Executive Regulations of Law No. 80/2002 issued by Cabinet Decree No. 56 of 2014; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; and the Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) rules requiring identification and verification of ultimate beneficial owners for non-banking financial institutions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public / Passport office in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the Egyptian incorporation agent/attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin, legalized by the Egyptian Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter for each subscribing shareholder (AML/CFT due diligence)
Board resolution of corporate shareholder (if applicable) authorizing the LLC incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing for any foreign corporate shareholder

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All proposed shareholders, directors, and UBOs must undergo mandatory PEP screening, OFAC SDN list checks, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list screening, scrutiny against the Egyptian Terrorism List, and adverse-media / reputational checks. Enhanced due diligence (EDD) is mandatory for any PEP, PEP-affiliated individuals, or transactions originating from high-risk third countries, in accordance with Egyptian AML Law No. 80/2002 as amended and international FATF standards.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Online Services – Commercial Registration and Company Incorporation Platform (www.gafi.gov.eg)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered corporate name must be in Arabic and may include an English or transliterated trade name only as a secondary name. The Arabic name must be distinct, comply with public order and Sharia norms, and end with the legal form 'Limited Liability Company' (شركة ذات مسئولية محدودة) or its accepted abbreviation. The foreign-language name must be a direct transliteration or translation of the Arabic name and may not create a confusingly similar reference to any existing registered trademark or company.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may submit a written administrative appeal to the GAFI Commercial Registration Appeal Committee within 15 working days of the notification date, attaching the original rejection notice and up to three revised name alternatives. The Committee must issue a decision within 30 days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may file a judicial challenge before the Economic Court. A new name reservation application and fee are required if the initial 30-day reservation window lapses without formal incorporation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are not accepted as the primary registered address for an LLC engaged in manufacturing of ISIC 3250. A physical registered office and, for production activities, a physical factory or industrial premises address are mandatory for GAFI licensing, commercial registration, product authorization by the Ministry of Health, and tax authority inspections. Virtual office services may be used only for ancillary administrative mail handling after the physical address is established.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High; approximately 70-80% likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first 12 months of incorporation by GAFI, Ministry of Health (medical-device production), labor authorities, and the Egyptian tax authority. The probability increases significantly if manufacturing authorization or medical-device registration is sought.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 180 of 2018), Book 3 - Limited Liability Company provisions, Articles 19-44; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Companies Registration Directorate, Cairo
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation (Shahadat Ta'sees) issued upon registration of the Contract of Incorporation and Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Sharika wa Nizamaha Al-Asasi)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for LLCs after Law 180/2018 abolished the prior EGP 50,000 floor; the founders fix the capital freely, and subscribed shares must be fully paid in cash and deposited into a preliminary blocked escrow account at a licensed Egyptian bank, with the bank deposit certificate attached to the incorporation file.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: 1) The Founders subscribe in full to the issued capital and adopt the Articles of Association executed before the competent Notary; 2) The registered office is established at the address stated in the incorporation file, and the General Manager is authorized to ratify the lease and obtain the occupancy certificate; 3) [Name] is appointed General Manager and [Name] is appointed Chief Financial Officer, each with ordinary management powers and joint signing authority over bank accounts; 4) The General Manager is authorized to obtain tax, commercial registry, civil defense, and industrial operating licenses and to open the corporate bank account; and 5) The first external auditor is appointed for the inaugural fiscal year.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legal Structuring, Name Reservation, and Electronic Pre-Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Portal (investorportal.gafi.gov.eg) and GAFI One-Stop Shop, Cairo
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the name reservation request and pre-incorporation data electronically; verify the LLC's Arabic name, scope, capital, and managers against the commercial name database; obtain the name reservation approval and a preliminary filing reference number before executing statutory documents.
required_dossiers: Authenticated passport/national ID copies of all founders/managers
Draft Contract of Incorporation and Articles of Association in Arabic
Power of Attorney for local representative (if founder is non-resident)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name or activity is rejected, the applicant may refile a corrected name/scope twice without additional GAFI service charges; a formal administrative appeal is available within 15 days of rejection notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Execution of Statutory Incorporation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Justice - Notary Public Authority (Office of the Competent Notary, Cairo)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before the Notary Public with all parties or authorized attorneys; execute and notarize the Contract of Incorporation and Articles of Association; obtain certified copies and the notary stamp/seal required for GAFI filing.
required_dossiers: Name reservation approval certificate from GAFI
Full legal names, capacities, and signature specimens of founders
Notarially valid identification documents
Power of Attorney (if signing through a representative)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary raises signature or document defects, correct and re-execute the instrument on stamped paper; the notary office may reparallel file after payment of the stated amendment fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Deposit and Opening of the Preliminary Blocked Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank in Egypt (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr, or CIB)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a preliminary incorporation account in the future company's name; deposit the full subscribed capital in cash or by bank transfer; obtain the bank deposit certificate (Iqrar Iidicae) confirming the capital amount and that the funds are restricted until GAFI registration is completed.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association
Name reservation certificate
Founders' identification documents
Anti-money laundering declarations and source-of-funds statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank questions source of funds or beneficial owner documentation, provide a notarized statement of wealth and supporting bank statements; funds must remain blocked, and the deposit certificate will be reissued upon resolution of the KYC query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Statutory Incorporation Registration and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI - Companies Registration Directorate (One-Stop Shop), Cairo
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete statutory incorporation dossier online and in hard copy at the GAFI One-Stop Shop; pay the official registration fee and edara stamps; after legal screening of the Articles, obtain the Certificate of Incorporation (Shahadat Ta'sees), commercial register extract (Kayd Tigari), and the company seal.
required_dossiers: Notarized Contract of Incorporation and Articles of Association
Bank capital deposit certificate
Original and copies of founder/manager ID or passport
Tax clearance certificate (Rekab Daribi) of each founder (if resident)
Notarized Power of Attorney for incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues an observation or query, the applicant must cure the specific legal defect within 15 days; a formal re-submission after correction carries no additional substantive fee; administrative review seed exists under the Investment Law for unjustified refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Value-Added Tax Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - Taxpayer Registration Offices
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the incorporation certificate to the competent ETA unit; complete the corporate and payroll tax registration to obtain a Tax Card (Al-Bitaka Al-Daribia), VAT registration certificate, and electronic invoicing sign-up; verify the industrial activity code (ISIC 3250) matches the intended manufacturing scope.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and commercial register extract
Articles of Association
Bank account details and deposit certificate
Lease contract for the registered office
Authorized manager's ID and signatures
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If ETA delays or questions the classification, request re-classification based on the ISIC code declared and provide the lease and manufacturing proof to trigger a joint ETA-GAFI reconciliation; the applicant may escalate in writing to the ETA customer complaints bureau.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Chamber of Commerce and Labor Registration, then Corporate Bank Account Release
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Federation of Egyptian Chambers of Commerce - Commercial Registration Section; Ministry of Manpower - Labor Registration Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company with the competent Chamber of Commerce committee and obtain the chamber card; register the establishment with the Ministry of Manpower for labor file and work permits; then present all registration certificates to the bank to release the blocked capital into the operational corporate account.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and commercial register extract
Tax card
Registered office lease and utility bill
List of prospective employees and responsible manager's decision
Bank account opening resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If chamber or manpower filing is rejected over document mismatches, amend the lease or manager designation at the Commercial Registry and refile the designation decision; manual waiver may be processed upon demonstration that the physical factory, not the registered office, is the operational workplace.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) - Central Department for Industrial Licensing, Ministry of Trade and Industry
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operating License (Rekhasat Tashghil Sinaeii) and Record of Industrial Establishment (Al-Sijill Al-Sinaeii) under Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2017

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) - Environmental Impact Assessment and Industrial Pollution Control Departments
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Summary Environmental Assessment / Initial Environmental Examination (IEE) for thermoforming medical-device plastics; a full EIA report is triggered exceptionally for facilities located in environmentally sensitive zones or with solvent/VOC usage above the screening threshold, in accordance with EIA Guidelines (Law 4/1994, amended by Law 9/2009)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge to public sewer must comply with Law 48/1982 and Decree 44/2000 parameter limits (pH 6-9.5, TSS within 50-350 mg/L, BOD within 30-235 mg/L applicable to the receiving system); process emissions from thermoforming and trimming shall not exceed the permissible ambient airborne pollutant limits under Prime Ministerial Decree No. 1095/2011; waste handling and disposal of polymer off-cuts and contaminated trims must follow the solid waste management provisions of Law 4/1994 and its Executive Regulation No. 338/1995 (amended by Regulation 37/2005)

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by the General Administration of Civil Defense approving the fire-fighting system, emergency exits, and thermoforming machine heat protection zones; structural load inspection by the Municipal Engineering Department for the industrial premise confirming floor-load capacity for trimming and lamination equipment; occupational health and safety clearance from the Ministry of Manpower under Labor Law No. 12/2003 covering workplace air quality, noise exposure below 85 dB(A), hazard marking, and a permanent safety officer appointment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance; official e-services: ETA Taxpayer Portal (https://www.eta.gov.eg) and the mandatory E-Invoicing and E-Receipts Platform (https://einvoicing.eta.gov.eg).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned EG_LLC must first complete commercial registration to obtain the Commercial Identification Number (CID), then file the statutory tax registration application with the ETA within 30 days of commencing activity; the ETA issues a single unified Tax Identification Number (Tax Card/File Number) covering corporate income tax, VAT, and payroll/stamp taxes, together with the Tax Card. For electronic invoicing, the taxpayer must separately onboard on the ETA E-Invoicing Portal, submit corporate documentation (CID, Tax Card, power of attorney, authorized signatory ID), and obtain API credentials (client ID/client secret) for the E-Invoice and E-Receipt systems.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt has no US-style check-the-box election; all domestic LLCs are statutory entity-level taxpayers. Elections that can modify the indirect tax and duty profile: (i) voluntary VAT registration at an EGP 100,000 annual turnover threshold (mandatory at EGP 500,000); (ii) application through GAFI for Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 incentives, including the General Free Zone or Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) regimes under which VAT and customs duties are replaced by alternative levy arrangements for project inputs; (iii) no VAT-group or tax consolidation election is available; hybrid mismatch elections do not exist in Egyptian domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016 (as amended by Law No. 7 of 2022) and its Executive Regulations
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration: EGP 500,000 of annual taxable supplies of goods/services; voluntary registration is permitted from EGP 100,000 of annual turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt operates a mandatory real-time electronic invoice clearance system under Ministerial Decrees No. 201 of 2020 (e-invoices) and No. 623 of 2021 (e-receipts). All invoices must be submitted in XML/JSON via secure API to the ETA E-Invoicing Platform, validated against ETA master data (supplier, customer, product codes, VAT rates), and returned with an ETA-assigned UUID and QR code before the invoice becomes legally effective. Integration is a condition for input VAT deduction and for customs release of zero-rated export consignments. Failure to integrate or to issue ETA-cleared invoices disqualifies the 0% export claim, triggers penalties of up to EGP 50,000 per document, and causes denial of input VAT credit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating under Article 17(1) of the VAT Law applies to thermoformed dental clear aligner sheets when the goods are sold and physically exported by the Egyptian registered supplier outside Egypt and the supplier retains proof of customs exit and receipt of the export proceeds in Egypt. Offshore services supplied by the Egyptian entity to non-resident beneficiaries outside Egypt may also qualify as zero-rated exported services when the service is consumed entirely outside Egypt; the supplier must maintain contracts, delivery evidence, and banking records demonstrating the offshore nature of the supply.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration processed through the Egyptian National Single Window (NAFEZA) with export duty/tax clearance stamp
Transport document evidencing physical exit: Bill of Lading, Sea Waybill, or Air Waybill
Commercial invoice bearing the zero-rated VAT treatment code and the ETA-cleared e-invoice QR code
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by the Egyptian dealing bank evidencing receipt of export proceeds in Egypt
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA may reassess within five years and will claw back input VAT credited on zero-rated exports plus 14% VAT if the customs exit, remittance, or documentation trail is deficient; monthly delay damages accrue at up to 2% per month on the unremitted tax, and e-invoices not cleared by the ETA at the time of export are automatically disallowed. Fraudulent zero-rating claims (including fictitious exports, circular trade, or unrepatriated proceeds) attract criminal penalties under the VAT Law of imprisonment and fines of not less than EGP 50,000, double tax on the falsely zero-rated value, exclusion from the exporters' registry, and mandatory bank-level repatriation enforcement by the Central Bank of Egypt.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), acting under the Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 194 of 2020, together with the Egyptian Customs Authority, the General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC), and the relevant rules of the Ministry of Finance and Egyptian Tax Authority.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Egyptian pound is generally convertible for bona fide current-account transactions, including payment for imported goods and services, subject to bank-level documentary review, sanctions screening, customs and tax documentation, and available foreign-currency liquidity. Capital-account transactions, shareholder funding, intercompany loans, dividends, royalties, management fees, and other profit repatriations are not subject to a single universal statutory prohibition but are controlled through licensed-bank procedures, corporate records, tax clearance or tax-payment evidence, audited financial statements, board or shareholder approvals, and evidence that the underlying transaction is genuine. Foreign exchange access may be affected by market liquidity, CBE directives, bank risk policies, import restrictions, and applicable sector or free-zone rules. The LLC should maintain a registered capital file, shareholder funding ledger, bank advices, customs records, audited accounts, withholding-tax evidence, and transfer-pricing support before requesting dividend or service-fee remittances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Egypt does not generally impose a universal statutory requirement that every exporter surrender a fixed percentage of export proceeds or convert all foreign-currency receipts into Egyptian pounds. Export proceeds should be collected through authorized banks and reconciled to the relevant commercial invoice, customs export declaration, shipping evidence, and banking or export-control records. Applicable CBE, banking, customs, GOEIC, free-zone, and sector-specific instructions may prescribe reporting, collection, or repatriation periods for particular transactions or exporter categories; no single statutory timeline or mandatory conversion ratio should be assumed without checking the current bank circulars and the company's export regime. The company should obtain written confirmation from its authorized bank before implementation and retain proof of export, receipt, conversion, and any permitted foreign-currency retention.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account; capital funding account subject to bank acceptance
Operational Account; capital funding account subject to bank acceptance
Operational Account; capital funding account subject to bank acceptance

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for payment collection and expense management, but low as a substitute for an Egyptian corporate bank account. An offshore electronic-money institution or payment service provider cannot independently open a regulated Egyptian deposit account, conduct unrestricted local foreign-exchange dealing, receive capital contributions as an Egyptian bank, or bypass CBE, AML, customs, tax, and import-document controls. Stripe or another platform may be used only if the relevant Egyptian merchant onboarding, acquiring, settlement, product, and current-country availability rules permit it. Settlement to an offshore account may create foreign-exchange, tax, permanent-establishment, consumer-protection, and merchant-of-record issues. The company should use a CBE-licensed Egyptian bank as its primary account, obtain written platform eligibility confirmation, and reconcile platform statements to Egyptian sales, VAT, corporate-income-tax, and foreign-exchange records.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Egyptian banks commonly require original or legalized corporate documents, specimen signatures, beneficial-owner identification, authorized-signatory verification, tax registration evidence, and a compliance interview. Physical attendance by directors is not uniformly mandated by statute in every case; some banks permit remote onboarding or use notarized, legalized, consular, or apostilled documents subject to their policies. Authorized signatories, foreign shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, or high-risk counterparties may nevertheless be required to attend in person or complete video identification. Remote opening should not be treated as guaranteed. Confirm requirements with the selected bank before incorporation funding, and arrange powers of attorney, Arabic translations, legalization, and corporate resolutions in advance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear ultimate beneficial ownership, nominee ownership, layered foreign holding companies, or inability to evidence the controlling individual.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified constitutional documents for every ownership layer; current commercial-register extracts; ownership chart to natural persons; passports and proof of address for shareholders, directors, and UBOs; UBO declaration; shareholder register; notarized powers of attorney; sanctions and politically exposed person screening records.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign shareholder funding with no clear capital, loan, or shareholder-current-account classification.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Foreign-investment or incorporation documents; shareholder and board resolutions; subscription or loan agreement; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth evidence; SWIFT payment message; remitter-to-shareholder ownership trail; bank purpose code; capital-account or shareholder-loan ledger; tax and accounting treatment memorandum.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Dental aligner manufacturing viewed as medical-device activity without regulatory authorization or an adequate product description.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial-register and tax-card records; industrial-license or operating-license evidence; product classification; Ministry of Health or Egyptian Drug Authority analysis or authorization where applicable; factory and environmental approvals; quality-management certificates; manufacturing flowchart; invoices and customer profile; declaration that the company does not provide unlicensed clinical services.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected exports, imports, or foreign-currency transactions inconsistent with the declared business profile or lacking customs documentation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business plan; three-year cash-flow forecast; supplier and customer contracts; pro forma invoices; HS-code analysis; import and export registrations; customs declarations; bills of lading; certificates of origin; commercial invoices; packing lists; insurance documents; expected transaction-volume schedule.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments involving high-risk jurisdictions, sanctioned persons, restricted goods, dual-use materials, or opaque intermediaries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Counterparty KYC files; beneficial-owner certificates; sanctions screening reports; end-use and end-user certificates; shipping route and vessel screening; denied-party checks; product technical specifications; compliance approval matrix; contractual sanctions clauses; escalation and rejection records.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large unexplained cash activity, personal-account usage, third-party payments, or rapid pass-through of foreign currency.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Treasury policy prohibiting personal accounts and unapproved third-party payments; approved signatory matrix; bank statements; payment-register reconciliation; invoice-to-contract matching; cash-use prohibition; monthly management accounts; exception approvals; internal audit evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Dividend, royalty, management-fee, or intercompany-service remittance requested without audited profits, tax evidence, or arm's-length support.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements; shareholder resolution; retained-earnings schedule; tax returns and tax-payment or clearance evidence; withholding-tax computation; intercompany agreement; transfer-pricing analysis; service-delivery evidence; timesheets and invoices; related-party disclosure; bank remittance application.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign directors or UBOs unable to provide legalized documents, local contact details, or a credible explanation of management and operational substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Legalized passports and address evidence; notarized corporate resolutions; local office or factory lease; employee and payroll records; management-services arrangements; organizational chart; operating-license evidence; local accountant and legal counsel engagement letters; video-interview availability.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route shareholder equity, shareholder loans, and other funding through the Egyptian LLC's account with a CBE-licensed bank. The remitter should be the documented shareholder, lender, or approved group treasury entity; avoid unrelated third-party remitters. Before payment, provide the bank with the funding agreement, corporate resolution, ownership chart, source-of-funds evidence, expected amount and currency, and requested classification as capital, shareholder loan, or other permitted funding. Use the bank's current purpose code and payment narrative, and require the bank to confirm any foreign-investment registration, capital-account documentation, or CBE reporting requirement. Reconcile the SWIFT payment, bank credit advice, general ledger, shareholder register, and statutory filings. Do not convert or distribute funds until the bank confirms clearance and classification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use the Egyptian bank's import and trade-finance desk for supplier payments. For open-account or advance payments, submit the commercial contract, pro forma or final invoice, HS-code and goods description, import-license or importer-registration evidence where required, customs and shipping documents, and supplier and UBO information. For documentary trade, use a commercial letter of credit issued or confirmed through an authorized bank, with compliant documents under the applicable UCP rules. For permitted direct bank transfers, use SWIFT MT103 or its current ISO 20022 equivalent, with an accurate purpose narrative and full beneficiary details. Reconcile the payment to customs entry, bill of lading or airway bill, invoice, packing list, and goods receipt. Do not use personal accounts, informal value-transfer systems, crypto settlement, or split payments intended to evade bank, customs, or AML review.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards with a CBE-licensed bank, supported by a documented underlying import, export, loan, dividend, or other bona fide exposure and subject to bank limits, suitability review, and current CBE rules.
FX swaps with a CBE-licensed bank for documented liquidity or maturity-management purposes, subject to counterparty limits, accounting treatment, and applicable regulatory approvals.

Non-deliverable forwards only where the authorized Egyptian bank offers the product and confirms that it is permitted for the company, the currency pair, the underlying exposure, and the applicable reporting framework; availability and legality should not be presumed.

Plain-vanilla currency options or structured hedges only after written confirmation from the authorized bank regarding product authorization, suitability, disclosure, valuation, collateral, and accounting requirements.
Natural hedging through matching export receipts, import payables, foreign-currency debt service, and permitted foreign-currency balances, with documented treasury limits and no speculative trading.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate accounts, auditor report, and annual general meeting records
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), where filing or inspection submission is required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual general meeting generally within three months after the end of the financial year; related accounts and resolutions retained and submitted in accordance with GAFI procedures
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: GAFI notices, administrative fines, restrictions on corporate services, and possible dissolution or strike-off proceedings after statutory enforcement steps; no universal automatic strike-off date

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the end of the financial year; for a calendar-year company, generally by 30 April of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties, interest or compensation for late payment, tax assessment, audit exposure, and potential administrative or criminal enforcement; no automatic corporate strike-off by the Tax Authority

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual review and update of corporate registration data
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI and the Commercial Registry, where an amendment or confirmation filing is required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Review annually and file changes promptly within the applicable statutory period; Egypt has no general standalone annual return equivalent to common-law jurisdictions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalties, inability to process subsequent amendments, registry discrepancies, and possible GAFI enforcement for persistent non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial ownership and partner-information review
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI, Commercial Registry, and competent anti-money-laundering authorities, as applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Conduct at least annually and update promptly following any change in ownership, control, management, or beneficial ownership; statutory filings apply when a reportable change occurs
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalties, enhanced regulatory scrutiny, restrictions on registry services, and potential anti-money-laundering enforcement

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An Egyptian LLC must assess mandatory auditor appointment and statutory audit requirements under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 and its Executive Regulations, including applicable capital, partner-number, and partner-request criteria. A licensed Egyptian auditor should confirm the current threshold and filing position.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards, which are substantially aligned with IFRS, subject to applicable Egyptian statutory and tax adjustments

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate universal annual UBO declaration is generally imposed solely because a year has elapsed. The company should perform an annual ownership and control review, maintain beneficial ownership information, and promptly update GAFI, Commercial Registry, and AML records after any transfer or control change.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Managers and authorized signatories

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 500-2,500 per year, excluding taxes and government charges
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 1,500-8,000 per year for a small Egyptian LLC; higher for manufacturing, regulated medical-device activities, inventory-intensive operations, or multi-site businesses

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Tax holidays for qualifying manufacturing in free zones (0% for up to 10 years), accelerated depreciation, R&D tax credits

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Egyptian Tax Authority Annual Corporate Income Tax Return via e-Tax portal (Form 100 equivalent)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net profit after allowable adjustments and deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents file through local tax representative; include branch profits and final withholdings

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for taxes withheld on cross-border payments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents claim credits via TRC or treaty relief

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty EGP 500 per day (max EGP 50,000), plus 1% of tax due per month of delay

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit TRC application to Egyptian Tax Authority with supporting documents; approval required prior to dividend payment to avoid WHT
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 10% statutory (0-5% under treaties); Interest: 15% statutory (reduced under treaties)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 500,000 for related-party transactions triggering local file requirement
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable under Egyptian Economic Substance Regulations for tax residency and controlled foreign entities

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Understatement of taxable income or falsification of records
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties: fines up to 100% of evaded tax, imprisonment up to 5 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability, civil restitution, and potential travel bans

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or submit TP documentation for related-party transactions above threshold
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines and potential disqualification from management

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to demonstrate adequate economic substance for tax residency or CFC status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties up to EGP 1 million and loss of tax benefits
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal penalties and possible imprisonment for willful non-compliance
